segments.text: The essence, the true essence or the one uniform essence or the single one undifferentiated nature.
It does not have different qualities, different contexts.
Do not present a different face to different observers.
He is the essential Rasa nature.
Therefore, the Kudastha Nirvakara Ekarasa, the triple definition of Akshara Swaroopa.
The three term definition, Kudastha Nirvikara Ekarasa is the Swaroopa Lakshana.
A definition through essential characteristics rather than Tadastha Lakshana.
These three together constitute that the tradition calls Nirguna Brahman self-nature.
This is the asman as the witness that is immovable ground of all movement.
The unchanged substratum of all change.
Having explained this, Krishna now gives the fruit of knowing this knowledge.
